title: Going back in time in dreams with the monks; Harry Heller says time is an illusion
summary: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen tells of Going back in time in dreams with the monks; Harry Heller says time is an illusion, about unspecified at dream (the mountain with the monks), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Which Harry Heller said to me in my book when I was in with the Monotones, and sure enough, he proved it was an illusion cuz I kept going back in time.

plain: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former senior officer at the CIA, the US intelligence agency, says that in dreams he visited a mountain with a group of monks he calls the Monotones and kept going back in time. He says a man named Harry Heller told him time is an illusion, and that his dream experiences proved it to him, an idea he links to Albert Einstein. If true, it would mean the mind can move through time.
